title: Four towers and differences
notes: First routes: K-1 P1 and P2 (orders of 0, 1, 2, 4), then either P4-5 for one- and two-move starts or P3 for a longevity search; grades 2-3 P1-3; grades 4-5 P1-2. On return, K-1 can compare three stations (P6). Grades 2-3 can investigate predecessors (P4), station count (P5) or maximum bounds (P6). Grades 4-5 can test predecessors (P3) and station count (P4), make parity shadows (P5), then connect scaling and boundedness to termination (P6-8). Retain all upper proofs for deeper visits. Always compute four outputs from one untouched old state, then clear the old mat and move the new towers onto it.
